objective: Support time-window conditions (mean/min/max) across IR, Rhai compiler, UI editor, and backend script execution chain with InfluxDB range pre-fetching.

acceptance.criterion: query_range_stat receives range_sec: i64 and queries InfluxDB with range(start: -{}s) using supported stat functions.
acceptance.verification: Cargo test stat_to_flux_fn validates stat translation and range_sec signature in hydragrow-backend/src/db/influx.rs

acceptance.criterion: ConditionSchema supports range mode (instant, mean, min, max) and enforces windowSec requirement for non-instant modes.
acceptance.verification: Vitest test validates ConditionSchema parsing for instant and time-window conditions in hydragrow-frontend/src/lib/automation/ir.test.ts

acceptance.criterion: compileToRhai produces fetch_range_stat(sensor, mode, windowSec) calls for non-instant conditions.
acceptance.verification: Vitest test validates Rhai code generation for mean/min/max conditions in hydragrow-frontend/src/lib/automation/compileToRhai.test.ts

acceptance.criterion: collect_range_stat_keys recursively extracts deduplicated non-instant (sensor, mode, windowSec) keys from IR JSON trees.
acceptance.verification: Cargo test range_stat_prefetch_tests validates key collection across nested conditions in hydragrow-backend/src/mqtt/handlers/script_eval.rs

acceptance.criterion: eval_flow_chain pre-fetches required range stat keys before Rhai evaluation and routes values into fetch_range_stat execution.
acceptance.verification: Cargo test eval_flow_chain_uses_real_range_stat_fetcher validates non-zero fetcher wiring in hydragrow-backend/src/mqtt/handlers/script_eval.rs

acceptance.criterion: ConditionGroupEditor LeafEditor UI allows picking range mode and editing window minutes, propagating windowSec in seconds.
acceptance.verification: Vitest test validates LeafEditor mode selector and windowSec conversion in hydragrow-frontend/src/components/automation/reactflow/ConditionGroupEditor.test.tsx
